Leaving a hard business partner meant starting with nothing.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a business partner who was incredibly difficult to deal with. He asked himself what his options were. Leaving meant being out of money, so that is what he did, and he says everything worked out fine.

He admits it is easier said than done, especially in a marriage, and that many people can't do it. His way to look at it: the universe doesn't do things to me, it does things for me.

What decision have you been putting off?
